title: Winter 1958-59 building of Hugh John Flemming Bridge
description: Some members of the construction crew who built the Hugh John Flemming Bridge at Hartland between 1958 and 1960. Partially completed piers are visible behind them. (Photo courtesy of Mitchelle Tibbits.)
